config key provider.api_key is not read from a checkout's file — a credential is yours, not the repository's;…

· [?] · the switch is in the register
shhh config · the checkout's file · .shhh/config.toml                                      [?] keys · [q] quit
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  …
  ❯ permission mode    ⏵⏵ auto — edits apply; allowlisted commands run                                    user
  ↓ 13 more

[↑↓/jk] move between settings
[enter] change the setting under the pointer
[/] filter the settings by name
[ctrl+u] clear the filter, or the field being typed into
[backspace] take a rune back out of either
[r] reset this setting to its default
[w] write every staged change to the checkout's .shhh/config.toml
[g] switch the write between the checkout's file and yours
[esc] leave the picker, or leave the screen writing nothing
[q] leave the screen writing nothing
[?] hide the keys
